title: Scene
description: A deterministic scene (#2415): starts on an EventEmitted in its instance, holds every player there and pauses wild attacks and hunts while running its steps in order. One file per scene in resourcepacks/default/scenes/<id>.jsonc.

id.description: Stable scene id, matching its file name: lowercase words joined by underscores.

instance.description: Optional instance blueprint id where this scene runs; omitted means any instance where its `on` event fires.

on.description: The EventEmitted name (legend emitting event, escape, or quest event) that starts this scene.

once.description: Whether this scene runs at most once per instance (default true).

steps.description: The steps the runner executes in order.

ticks.description: Whole ticks to wait before advancing.

actor.description: Actor id: an NPC id, a wild monster's quest target or species id, or player / player_0..player_3.

pace.description: Optional ticks per tile step; omitted uses the actor's natural pace.

lethal.description: Whether the strike may fell the target (default false: stops at 1 HP).

event.description: The EventEmitted name raised for quests and other rules.
